title: Viral Title
description: In today's episode of the AI Edge, hosts Alex and Jamie dive into a packed agenda, starting with the headlines of the day. They discuss Sauron, a high-end home security startup making waves with its premium offerings, and its recent strategic move to bring Peter Kraft, former head of strategy at Sonos, as the new CEO. The episode also covers insights into the financial markets, focusing on developments in Tokyo. This episode is sponsored by ElevenLabs, specializing in synthetic voice technology.
